status: development restart before any reporting/test outcomes
primary_endpoint: paired difference Direct minus MGDA-UB in final worst-attribute test accuracy
selection: highest final validation worst-attribute accuracy, tie broken by mean accuracy then lower learning rate; separately for each arm
model: ImageNet1K_V1 ResNet18 shared trunk with 40 linear binary heads
batchnorm: frozen affine and pretrained evaluation statistics for all methods
heads: own unweighted mean-BCE gradient in every method
optimizer: SGD momentum 0.9, no weight decay or clipping
direct: shared forward; task-batched output adjoints; FP64 tiled exact contractions; native weighted backward
mgda_ub: exact closed-form full batch-by-representation gradient Gram, FP64 accumulation; same checked simplex solver
data: first 16000 official train, first 4000 official validation, full official test, 64x64 RGB; pinned source revision and tensor hashes
uncertainty: 20 paired seed differences; mean and Student-t 95% interval; all per-seed results and a paired bootstrap sensitivity interval; no assumption that 20 seeds guarantees separation
quality_time_comparison: validation learning curves against cumulative update and wall time; separate equal-time extension of cheap methods required before a time-to-quality superiority claim
audits: independent serial shared-trunk Gram after updates 1, 601 and 1200; separate kernel initialization preflight; refuse mismatched or unresolved results
failure_policy: retain failure logs and seed identifiers; repair code prospectively with new version, rerun affected configurations; never silently omit an unfavorable seed
scope: This is a controlled 16k-training-subset comparison, not full-data CelebA convergence. Momentum execution has no common-descent guarantee. It does not replace the separately requested full QM9 benchmark.
